params.prompt:
Create an exciting, fun, polished 5-second square social ad video using the provided locksmith 1APP ad creative as the exact starting frame and the provided 1APP logo as the brand reference. Preserve the original ad layout, real 1APP logo, colors, emergency call UI, worker, van, headline, subtext, CTA button, and all existing text exactly as shown. All text must remain crisp, readable, and stable for the entire video.

Fun motion direction: 24/7 emergency response energy. Add subtle neon pulse on the call/AI UI cards, soft blue/gold glow accents, gentle parallax between worker/van/UI cards, and a clean push-in. Keep all typography locked and sharp. Do not invent or change text. Do not add new words, fake letters, extra buttons, warped logos, strange hands, extra fingers, distorted vehicles, or mutated UI. No cuts, no scene changes, no audio.
